headline: God of War Laufey gameplay explained
title: God of War Laufey Gameplay Explained | Faye's Sword, Rue and Soul Power
video_script: Here's how Faye fights in God of War Laufey. Her main weapon is a sword guarded by Rue, an enchanted ribbon. Faye is more mobile than Kratos and can switch between ground and air attacks without breaking a combo. Her golden palm can rip an enemy's soul out of its body, then you can attack the soul or smash it into other enemies. The game was revealed with twenty minutes of gameplay. Which move looks best to you? Comment below!
description: God of War Laufey gameplay: Faye wields a sword guarded by the enchanted ribbon Rue, chains ground and aerial attacks, and uses her golden palm to separate enemy souls from their bodies.
